name: ziptrrip-todo
description: Full-stack todo app: Express + SQLite REST API and a multi-page React frontend

scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently --names server,client --prefix-colors blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.test: npm test --prefix server && npm test --prefix client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix server && npm run typecheck --prefix client
